svg.aria-label: Weighted tokens per wake against the context the held supervisor had accumulated, by role, September
svg.title: Weighted tokens per wake against the context the held supervisor had accumulated, by role, September
svg.text: A held supervisor pays for its whole history on every wake (September, both repos)
Each dot is one wake into a held session: the context it carried in (x) and the weighted tokens it cost (y), gates and handshake included.
Blue: the wake acted (wrote, pushed, edited or dispatched). Orange: it changed nothing. The line is the median in each context band; wakes over 600k sit on the top edge.
